title: Bounded cumulative nonhalting probability
statement: Let $r$ be a randomized procedure mapping finite Boolean strings to either an output in $\alpha$ or no output, where $\alpha$ has decidable equality. Say that its nonhalting probability at time $t$ is $p_t$. The sum of $p_t$ over the first $K$ time indices is at most the rational number $B$, for every natural number $K$.
hypotheses_covered: $r$ maps finite Boolean strings to an optional output in $\alpha$
For every $K\in\mathbb N$, the sum of nonhalting probabilities over $t<K$ is at most $B$
caveat: The snippet uses `notHaltedProb` without including its definition, so the exact underlying probability model is not specified here.
